items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: The interviewer mentions Al Freeman as the first piano player in the band, but the interviewee (Bernard Steinau) does not respond with any personal anecdote, confirmation of interaction, or description of a relationship with Al Freeman.

ctx.x: When he played, he was a good drummer.
And who was the first piano player? Al Freeman.
Al Freeman. He's dead. Where was he from? Columbus so high, but he was living in New Orleans, he was playing with Sidney Derry. Oh.
